title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Jayasree TU…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Successful Redirection for Contact Form plugin up to version 2.0. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of a user's browser session.
